data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Inheritance. The isolated node inherits the 'survival of the fittest' dynamic from the neighbourhood but mutates the definition of 'fitness' from 'reproductive success' to 'informational content'. Refuted If: The definition of 'fitness' in science (informational content) can be shown to be operationally identical to 'reproductive success' (citation count/funding), nullifying the claimed mutation and reducing the relation to simple identity.
